edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved the distinct growth of faith and mutual love, affliction/afflict/afflicted, relief, angels of power, flame, vengeance, eternal destruction, presence/glory/strength, and glory/faith repetitions. Included our in 1:2 from bracketed NA28 wording and smoothed bringing vengeance on. Retained the shorter Lord Jesus title at 1:8.

chapters.decision: Preserved gathering, shaking, the three communication channels, lawlessness, son of destruction, sanctuary, neuter what restrains versus masculine the one who restrains, breath/mouth, signs/wonders, firstfruits and oral/written traditions.
